brief: User selected Engineered and requests larger layout and type changes plus fresher hues.

prompts.prompt:
Use the attached Engineered concept ONLY as a reference for its broad squared technical typography and the HackJudge product, not as a layout to copy. Create a materially reimagined high-fidelity desktop homepage concept board, two equal desktop views side by side: "Before the event · Zero projects" and "During the event · First submissions". All sample event details labeled illustrative in small board caption. Keep functional truth and SAME CONTENT: CivicHacks 2026, October 12, Innovation Center, purpose Build practical tools for stronger communities, View event / How to participate, three challenges Energy & climate / Access & inclusion / Public life with a useful short sentence each; chronological timeline 09:00 Kickoff / 10:00 Build / 15:00 Submit / 16:00 Demo; rubric Innovation / Impact / Execution; secondary calendar Community showcase Oct 25 / Code & Tell Nov 9 / All events. Before has ZERO project names, media, counts, teams or placeholder gallery. During exactly two simple project rows Voltify / Community energy-demand forecasting and AgriSense / Field sensors and crop insights; stage Building is underway; active Build and submit-by 15:00; message Judging opens after submissions close. No fake prizes, data, scores, attendance or live scoring claims. Actual web UI, not a poster or physical scene; no device frame or perspective. Navigation HackJudge / Events / Sign in; bold familiar functional controls, readable sans descriptions, clear hierarchy. PRIMARY identity teal. User loved Engineered but disliked muddy muted hues; choose fresher stronger COORDINATED hues. Major layout and type-scale changes are REQUIRED; do NOT reproduce original two-column hero with stacked track board and bottom timetable/footer. Be playful and distinctive, with real art direction and practical structure. No microgrids, fake telemetry, terminal controls, graphs, decoration-only illustration, abstract project art, neon glow, gradients, texture or glass. No hospital pastel branding. Typography broad squared geometric grotesk akin Eurostile, with purposeful variation in width/weight rather than original condensed sports headline. Keep clear comparison at identical scale.
DIRECTION TITLE "01 / Signal rail". Main canvas vivid DEEP TEAL #086772, very dark NAVY #112D37 and bright AQUA #6DDEDE, CHARGED AMBER #F0CC4B, clean offwhite #F5F7F1. No clay, dusty lavender or beige. Layout completely reorganized: NARROW VERTICAL TIMETABLE RAIL about 22% on LEFT, dark navy and substantial 09:00 / 10:00 / 15:00 / 16:00 labels; main event content RIGHT 78%. Navigation spans full width first. In main content very wide squared title 'CivicHacks' on one line with a bold huge '26' YEAR MARK integrated beside or under while full literal '2026' remains obvious. Date/location/action row close beneath title. Before: right main region below event identity is a three-row OPEN CHALLENGE INDEX on white, where each row begins a large readable track heading and brief, prominent thin aqua/gold fills in purposeful header cells instead of icon cards. Same-size descriptions, no redundant marketing labels. Rubric and compact calendar run low across right column, not broad light footer. Strong contrast between dark schedule rail and large bright main content, engineered data alignment with generous breathing room. During: timetable rail is unchanged and gold highlights Build; main event masthead becomes compact to give prime space to a clean white 'Projects arriving' table with 2 project rows; challenges become an aqua mini-index just underneath. Functional teal/white controls and golden primary action. Distinct content-first operating layout whose schedule remains an anchor while projects arrive. Squared wide headline, large tabular numbers in rail, clean normal-width sans body. No uppercase mono microtext.

DIRECTION TITLE "02 / Open field". LIGHT and vivid alternate within Engineered: main canvas very pale clear ICE CYAN #E6F5F4, deep TEAL #005C65 title and control ink, substantial TEAL region #067D87, clean WHITE #FFFFFF, fresh COBALT #255ED7 secondary accent and warm bright MELON #FFB06D secondary accent. No muddy or desaturated warm colors. Layout: white narrow navigation, then LARGE FULL-WIDTH TYPE-LED MASTHEAD spanning page, 'CivicHacks' in visibly extra-wide squared geometric lettering 68px, a large normal 2026 aligned at far right or below the title line; event stage/date/location/actions live in a compact readable strip directly underneath, not a column beside track cards. Below this, a WIDE TEAL SCHEDULE RIBBON immediately follows masthead with four times and states in offwhite text, current Build distinguished in ice cyan. Then main challenge section arranged as THREE OPEN TYPOGRAPHIC COLUMNS on ice canvas with huge short text labels 'Energy / & climate', 'Access / & inclusion', 'Public / life' and small actual descriptions, short cobalt/melon accent rules at tops, no icons or enclosing cards. Bottom is a quieter WHITE split region rubric left/calendar right. During: same masthead title slightly reduced, schedule ribbon persists; challenge columns collapse to readable three-link horizontal strip; a broad dark-teal PROJECT INTAKE section replaces their area, holding TWO generous white-text project rows and clear 'Projects arriving', no images, count or stats. This should feel a dramatically fresh broad daylight competition platform, open and architectural, different from both dark reference and vertical-rail variant. Title mixed case retains squared letter character, headline width is expressive, body normal clear sans, controls not all caps. Color roles purposeful and limited, no random colored icons.
